title: IR Slicing Script

dependencies.reason: ir-slice.schema.json must exist before IR slicing script can be written — script output validates against it

critical_notes: New file only: tools/bin/prepare_agent_inputs.py. Do NOT modify any existing PHP or Python files.
Slicing logic is fully specified in multi-agent-plan.md:251-268 — implement exactly. Function signature: slice_ir_for_group(ir: dict, ep_types: set) -> dict.
Output shape MUST validate against contracts/ir-slice.schema.json (Session 15). Use jsonschema.validate() — hard error on mismatch, no silent degradation.

EP group mapping (from multi-agent-plan.md:238-247): A1=ajax_nopriv+admin_post_nopriv, A2=ajax_priv+admin_post, A3=rest_route, A4=shortcode+block, A5=cron+init+template_redirect+filters. Agents B/D receive full IR, Agent C receives anomalies section only.
Output filenames: reports/<slug>-ir-slice-ajax-unauth.json, -ajax-auth.json, -rest.json, -shortcode.json, -other.json. Plus reports/<slug>-semgrep-filtered-{group}.json for semgrep hits.
unresolved_hooks and coverage_gaps in slices = always [] per ir-slice.schema.json maxItems:0 constraint (Agent D handles these from full IR).
Script should accept CLI args: --ir <path> --semgrep <path> --output-dir <dir>. Fail fast with descriptive error if input files missing.
Do NOT implement jsonschema validation of agent OUTPUT schemas in this session — that is the merge script's job (Session 17+). Only validate the IR slice output shape.
DI-15-01 reminder: phase3-gate-output.schema.json still missing. If < 5 lines to stub it, create stub; otherwise add to discovered_issues.
